notes: no soyoustart file exists in dossier/compute. This is the cheapest orderable modern dedicated machine documented: 6 cores and NVMe for EUR 29.99 beats the Hetzner auction's EUR 64 floor on price by half, and loses on memory (32 GiB against 128 GiB). Refutation to record: the historic advice to buy So you Start for cheap bare metal is stale as a website, because the domain sells nothing new; the product behind it still sells under the SYS SKU. One disagreement is left open: ovheco.com lists 24sys01-v1 as 'Currently out of stock' on the same date while the OVH API returns 1H-high and 1H-low stock, and the API is the vendor's own answer, so the finding follows the API.
